ambiguous_latency.query_text: LatencyBudgetBurn warning checkout Checkout p99 latency 2.4s, burning the latency budget 6x p99 on POST /api/checkout/pay drifted from 780ms to 2.4s over three hours, starting about 40 minutes before the earliest change in the window shipped. Error rate is normal and no deploy went out. A replay against the previous build reproduces the same p99, and the payments provider dashboard shows their own authorization latency up 900ms over the same period.

auth_key_rotation.query_text: TokenValidationFailures critical auth Auth token validation failing for 92% of requests Verifiers reject JWTs with 'unknown key id kid-2026-08'. Sessions issued before the last auth rollout still validate; new ones do not.

bad_deploy.query_text: HighErrorRate critical checkout Checkout 5xx error rate above 8% for 5 minutes HTTP 500s from POST /api/checkout/pay spiked from 0.2% to 8.4%. Errors mention 'payment intent state invalid'.

cert_expiry.query_text: TLSHandshakeErrors critical checkout TLS handshake failures on checkout ingress Clients report certificate validation errors: 'certificate has expired'. No recent deploys to checkout.

config_typo.query_text: CrashLoopBackOff critical checkout checkout pods crash-looping after config rollout Container exits with 'invalid literal for int(): 30s' while parsing db_pool_timeout from config/checkout.yaml.

db_migration_lock.query_text: SlowQueries critical orders Orders p99 query latency above 4s; lock waits climbing pg_stat_activity shows ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock on orders table held by a CREATE INDEX statement; order list queries queueing behind it.

dependency_bump.query_text: HighLatency warning orders Orders p95 latency doubled to 900ms Upstream calls from orders to inventory take 2x longer since this morning; connection pool reuse appears broken after an HTTP client upgrade.

hotfix_regression.query_text: OrderQueryTimeouts critical orders Orders read queries timing out for 11% of requests GET /api/orders returns 504 after 30s. Postgres shows long-running SELECTs holding connections; statement_timeout no longer cancels them.

memory_leak.query_text: HighMemory warning inventory Inventory pods above 90% memory, restarting every ~6h RSS grows linearly since yesterday's release; OOMKilled twice overnight. Heap dominated by SKU lookup cache entries.

partial_revert.query_text: PaymentFailures critical checkout Checkout payment failure rate above 6% for 5 minutes POST /api/checkout/pay returns 'price mismatch between quote and charge' for 6.3% of attempts. A revert of the dynamic pricing rollout is merged on main but has not been deployed.

shared_db_saturation.query_text: ConnectionPoolExhausted critical payments-db payments-db connection pool at 100% for 4 minutes Clients wait 8s+ for a connection and time out with 'pool exhausted, 0 idle'. Checkout and orders both report downstream 5xx.
